_meta.domain_name: Baseball Team and Player Data Management
_meta.definition: The process of managing data related to schools, players, games, awards, and team statistics.

Schools._description: Captures information about baseball schools, including their unique identifiers, full names, cities, states, and countries.

columns.name: ﻿schoolID

columns.name: country
columns.description: Stores the country of origin for schools in baseball database.
